actual_scope: An exact snapshot-equivalence criterion, constructive failure witness and safe-ordering theorem for arbitrary finite dirty Boolean XOR sweeps whose destinations are distinct.
scope_change_reason: The suggested card concerns a complete selected caller assumption. This original side result isolates a finite-coordinate safety condition relevant to owned_erasure and compiler batching; it does not discharge either selected assumption or recheck a predecessor.
bottleneck_link: Owner injection alone does not justify replacing serial mutable reads by entry-snapshot reads. The result supplies a necessary and sufficient batching guard under a precise unique-destination contract, before any physical routing or child-volume claim.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified batching criterion and its witness-producing guard; do not expand into repeated-write words, new owner charts or supplier admission.
evidence: Written first-conflict proof and reverse-topological construction. The executable independently compares full Boolean operators for all 160579 ordered admitted words on 1..5 cells: 4833 safe, 155746 unsafe, each unsafe case has a literal basis witness. Independent reachability checks safe-order existence, with 141736 cyclic words. It also runs 512 dirty multi-bit executions, 16 invalid-input rejections and six boundary controls including 4096-cell chain/cycle limits and repeated-write cancellation.
